text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (SEV2) - apac-embed-store experiencing elevated 5xx/504 for embedding reads. Early estimate: ~5% of embedding requests affected; increased tail latency.

riya (oncall): oncall here. paging storage + infra. noticing spike around 03:10 UTC. pulling replication/compaction metrics.

infra-bot: ```
# kubectl -n embed-store logs embed-store-2 -c compactor | tail -n 30
I0312 03:12:05 compactor.go:214] starting shard compaction id=shard-87
I0312 03:12:06 compactor.go:337] held read-lock for shard-87 for 3.2s
WARN 03:15:12 http: request canceled while waiting for connection (Client.Timeout)
```

tomas (storage): compaction job appears to take locks that block embedding index reads on hot shards. compaction ramp started at 03:10 as part of routine nightly window.

hana (support): CS reporting production regressions for a few PLG customers and one enterprise. Adding note to status page and sending initial customer comms.

riya (oncall): mitigation: pausing scheduled compactions in apac region and failing-over read traffic to warm replicas where compaction isn't running. rolling now.

infra-bot: failover command executed; reads redirected to replica pool-2b. Observed immediate drop in 5xx from 5.1% -> 0.6% on redirected requests.

cs-lead: status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/203000 - "Investigating embedding read errors in APAC. Mitigation in progress; compactions paused." Contact: enterprise@redwood.ai for urgent cases.

tomas (storage): root cause likely compactor taking exclusive read-locks during a path that should allow concurrent reads. Will ship patched compactor that uses MVCC snapshotting. Preparing canary.

riya (oncall): monitoring for 20m; if stable we'll mark mitigated and schedule full rollout of the compactor patch with a maintenance window.

hana (support): customers notified of mitigations; two customers requested postmortem.

status-bot: Incident update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/203000 - "Mitigation observed; reads routed to replicas. Engineering preparing patch."

riya (oncall): RESOLVED at 2026-09-12T03:24:10Z. Compactor patch deployed to canary and rolled to prod after verification. Embedding reads back to baseline. RCA and action items to follow (patch, test for compaction concurrency, add compaction-safety toggle). :white_check_mark:
